lines.text: This rodent barely ages... and almost never gets cancer.
Meet the naked mole-rat: pink, wrinkly, nearly hairless, and all teeth.

parts.tts: Meet the naked mole-rat: pink, wrinkly, nearly hairless, and all teeth.
parts.heard: Meet the naked mole rat, pink, wrinkly, nearly hairless, and all teeth.

lines.text: A house mouse this size lives four years, tops. This one? Over 30.

parts.tts: A house mouse this size lives four years, tops. This one? Over thirty.
parts.heard: A house mouse this size lives four years. Tops. This one? Over 30.

lines.text: But here's the crazy part: its risk of dying doesn't go up with age.

parts.tts: But here's the crazy part: its risk of dying doesn't go up with age.
parts.heard: But here's the crazy part. Its risk of dying doesn't go up with age.

lines.text: And big colonies watched for years? Not a single case of cancer.

parts.tts: And big colonies watched for years? Not a single case of cancer.
parts.heard: and big colonies watched for years, not a single case of cancer.

lines.text: But it gets weirder. They live like ants, with one queen in charge.

parts.tts: But it gets weirder. They live like ants, with one queen in charge.
parts.heard: But it gets weirder. They live like ants, with one queen in charge.

lines.text: Only the queen has babies. The rest dig tunnels, guard, and babysit.

parts.tts: Only the queen has babies. The rest dig tunnels, guard, and babysit.
parts.heard: Only the queen has babies. The rest dig tunnels, guard, and babysit.

lines.text: And when the air runs out? It survives 18 minutes with zero oxygen.

parts.tts: And when the air runs out? It survives eighteen minutes with zero oxygen.
parts.heard: And when the air runs out, it survives 18 minutes with zero oxygen.

lines.text: Its body switches to burning fructose, a sugar, instead.

parts.tts: Its body switches to burning fructose, a sugar, instead.
parts.heard: its body switches to burning fructose, a sugar, instead.

lines.text: Scientists now study it for clues to aging... in us.

parts.tts: Scientists now study it for clues to aging...
parts.heard: Scientists now study it for clues to aging.
